schema_version: D57/D61 frozen public meanings; D63 narrow-table skeleton
scope: first-five accepted metadata plus future domestic expansion outputs when independently receipted

fields.name: JOB_HASH
fields.meaning: canonical job identity; public aggregate use only

fields.name: RECORD_SOURCE_ROW
fields.meaning: Records-side join locator; preserve multiplicity and missingness

fields.name: COMPANY_ID
fields.meaning: scraper company identity, not legal parent

fields.name: OCCUPATION_MAJOR
fields.meaning: current-delivery O*NET major occupation; missing/unofficial retained

fields.name: CENSUS_REGION
fields.meaning: deterministic region from Records STATE; missing/unmapped retained separately

fields.name: CREATED_YEAR
fields.meaning: observation metadata, not body publication/effective time

fields.name: metadata_join_state
fields.meaning: 1:1, no-match, missing code, unofficial occupation, unmapped geography and other failures remain explicit

fields.name: evidence_state
fields.meaning: candidate rule-observed evidence with unknown/conditional/empty/failed states; not semantic gold

fields.name: entry_junior_text
fields.meaning: cannot distinguish title from body; report as combined text indicator only

fields.name: graduate_evidence
fields.meaning: evidence scope is not recorded; cannot be treated as an unconditional requirement

fields.name: explicit_no_experience
fields.meaning: scope is available and must be reported separately by scope

fields.name: processing_status
fields.meaning: posting processing partition; processed and invalid_text are retained separately

fields.name: flags_json
fields.meaning: posting frozen-rule flag bundle; public aggregates only

fields.name: experience_status
fields.meaning: posting-level derived experience state; unknown remains explicit

fields.name: rule_version
fields.meaning: frozen extraction rule version

fields.name: overlay_version
fields.meaning: frozen relation-overlay version

fields.name: text_sha256
fields.meaning: text integrity hash; no text content

fields.name: evidence_kind
fields.meaning: evidence category such as experience, technology or entry

fields.name: evidence_rule
fields.meaning: frozen rule identifier

fields.name: start_offset
fields.meaning: private evidence coordinate; aggregate use only

fields.name: end_offset
fields.meaning: private evidence coordinate; aggregate use only

fields.name: quote
fields.meaning: private evidence text; never enters Git

fields.name: coordinate_system
fields.meaning: coordinate convention for evidence offsets

fields.name: objects_json
fields.meaning: candidate object list; four experience objects are general_work, occupation_task, industry_domain, tool

fields.name: strength
fields.meaning: literal evidence strength field; not a job minimum

fields.name: scope
fields.meaning: evidence scope; unknown remains separate

fields.name: duration_kind
fields.meaning: literal duration clause indicator

fields.name: lower_years
fields.meaning: literal lower-years value; not a job minimum

fields.name: upper_years
fields.meaning: literal upper-years value; not a job maximum

fields.name: outcome_status
fields.meaning: rule outcome status; unresolved retained

fields.name: technology
fields.meaning: non-negated technology family indicator

fields.name: role_cue
fields.meaning: role cue indicator

fields.name: negated
fields.meaning: negation marker for evidence

fields.name: d57_current_duty_mentoring_candidate
fields.meaning: D57 current-duty mentoring candidate; candidate marker, not semantic gold

boundaries: No direct global-key claim until cross-set audit receipt
No semantic accuracy, population, historical-text or causal claim
Do not use old 6,010,975 candidate frame as D63 denominator

derived_public_metrics.meaning: Public metrics are derived only from the frozen posting/evidence fields above; no additional private columns are invented. Literal clause years are not job minimums. Evidence quotes and coordinates remain private.
